topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I just found out that my neighbor is planning to put up a fence. It’s quite the project, apparently, and I didn’t see this coming at all. They mentioned wanting more privacy, which is understandable, but the design they chose seems a bit extreme—tall and solid, almost fortress-like. I’ve lived here for years, and our little cul-de-sac has always been so open and friendly. I guess things change, and people need their space. I’m curious to see how everyone else reacts. I think I’ll go over and chat with them, maybe offer some input. It’s their property, of course, but a bit of input can’t hurt, right?
